say:0:1523624001:0.text: You examine the horses closely. Although they are lean due to a lack of food, their bodies are strong. Illness can be ruled out as the cause of their frenzy.
say:0:1523624001:0.source_cn: 你仔细地检查了这些马匹的状态。虽然因饥荒的缘故，这些马...
say:0:1523624001:0.male: You examine the horses closely. Although they are lean due to a lack of food, their bodies are strong. Illness can be ruled out as the cause of their frenzy.
say:0:1523624001:0.female: You examine the horses closely. Although they are lean due to a lack of food, their bodies are strong. Illness can be ruled out as the cause of their frenzy.

say:1:1523624002:1.text: You glance at their legs as they stomp the ground impatiently. Their hooves are spotless and well-polished. Yan has been taking good care of them, so they aren't in a bad mood.
say:1:1523624002:1.source_cn: 你将视线挪向了马的腿部——它正极度不耐烦地蹬着地面——...
say:1:1523624002:1.male: You glance at their legs as they stomp the ground impatiently. Their hooves are spotless and well-polished. Yan has been taking good care of them, so they aren't in a bad mood.
say:1:1523624002:1.female: You glance at their legs as they stomp the ground impatiently. Their hooves are spotless and well-polished. Yan has been taking good care of them, so they aren't in a bad mood.

say:2:1523624003:1.text: Yan mentioned the horses have been to Windchoke Fen. Upon closer inspection, you notice faint traces of magic lingering on them.
say:2:1523624003:1.source_cn: 士兵提到，这些马曾去过风沼战场。你在检查时，也确实发现...
say:2:1523624003:1.male: Yan mentioned the horses have been to Windchoke Fen. Upon closer inspection, you notice faint traces of magic lingering on them.
say:2:1523624003:1.female: Yan mentioned the horses have been to Windchoke Fen. Upon closer inspection, you notice faint traces of magic lingering on them.

say:3:1523624004:1.text: The answer is obvious—the horses came under the influence of the God of Harvest's lingering power at Windchoke Fen.
say:3:1523624004:1.source_cn: 答案呼之欲出。看来，这些马是被风沼战场上残余的神堕力量...
